identitiesByConstruction.statement: Implied x_n from successive settlement averages is the unique number satisfying the cumulative-mean recurrence; partial-sum checks near zero only restate arithmetic.
Once x1..x59 are taken from settlement and As, At are given, computing T0=60*At-sum(x1..x59) and comparing x60-T0 to 60*(As-At) is an algebraic identity, not an independent test of membership.

If both fields average the same underlying 1Hz series with #118 membership, trailing at close+1s must equal settlement at close. Observing equality supports that shared-membership hypothesis but is the predicted identity, not a separate constraint. It does not bind either field to official expiration.

independentConstraints.detail: One fixed windowStart; 60 updates; count 1..60; windowEnd advances +1000ms each step — consistent with documented quarter-hour accumulation.
All 118 successive trailing transitions shift start and end by +1000ms; no fixed-start growing trailing series — consistent with documented trailing window.
Same declared [close-60s, close) labels with count 60 yield As!=At (gap=-0.08966666). Supports #118 claim that identical payload labels need not imply identical membership.

Under swap model, 60*(As-At) equals T_close-T_start. Using settlement-implied x60 as T_close yields a numeric T_start, but T_start is not published as its own field; the peel from trailing is not an independent confirmation (see identities).
